tools.name: verify_location
tools.description: Confirm a physical fact: a business is open and operating, a property exists and matches its listing, signage, occupancy, condition, an address is real. Returns geotagged timestamped photos, a 60-second egocentric clip, a yes/no with confidence score, and a two-line signed attestation.

tools.name: inspect_property
tools.description: Structured condition report for a property, unit, vehicle, equipment, job site or storm damage: 30-100 photos to a checklist, measurements where asked, a defect list with severity, a one-page report, signed attestation.

tools.name: technical_survey
tools.description: Technical survey by an engineer: robot-deployment site readiness (power, network, bay, floor, elevator, access), building systems and equipment condition, measured reports for lenders and boards, documentation packs for a licensed engineer's milestone work. Attestation states a qualified observation

tools.name: environment_assessment
tools.description: Clinically informed environment assessment by a nurse: home-safety and discharge-readiness, assisted-living and facility inspections, medically credible incident witness. Structured assessment to the customer's instrument with photos. Attestation states an environment report, not clinical care or di

tools.name: witness_event
tools.description: Be present and record: a delivery, an installation, a signing, a meter reading, a robot demo, an inventory count. Returns continuous egocentric video, timestamps, and a written sequence of what happened.

tools.name: collect_item
tools.description: Pick up or hand over a physical item: documents, a device, a sample kit, a key, a check. Returns a chain-of-custody log with photos at both ends and signatures captured. Declared contents only; no cash, controlled items, weapons or hazardous materials.

tools.name: test_action
tools.description: Perform a defined physical action and report: open the door with the code, test the lock, run the appliance, stand where the robot will stand and measure. Returns video of the action, pass/fail against the written criteria, and measurements.

tools.name: stand_in
tools.description: Be the human for an agent-run process: let the technician in, sign for the delivery, attend the walkthrough, answer the inspector's questions from a script; safety officer on site for a robot deployment (nurse). Returns video, the script as executed, and a written outcome.
